messages.subject: Help on GAMM fit with INLA
parts:
Hello INLA groups,

I was trying to fit an additive mixed model like gamm() function using INLA for continuous gaussian longitudinal data, where each subject has a different number of measurements. Suppose the gamm model with 2nd degree spline model for covariate t_{ij} is given by

y_{ij}= \beta_1*covariates + f(t_{ij}) + b_{0i} + b_{1i}*time + \epsilon_{ij}, 
where 
image.png
The model is fitted with INLA as follows;
inla.fit = inla(Y~ time * weight + I(time^2)+
                       f(Intercept_ID, model="iid") +  
                       f(slope_id, time , model="iid") +
                       f(Spline_ID, model="z", Z=Z),
                     data=TT, family="gaussian",control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE),
                     control.family=list(hyper=list(prec = list(param = c(.001, 0.001)))),
                     control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE))
My interest is to construct simultaneous confidence intervals for the first derivatives of the spline (of this form click here), where the derivative is 
image.png
For gam fitted object, ginla() function from mgcv package was helpful, this function is not suitable for gamm() model. How can I do this for INLA fit object,  Any help would be appreciated.  

Regards
Tafere
